brief: Prioritize immediate consequences before applying a simple balance or rate ordering.

title.es-MX: Revisa consecuencias antes de ordenar deudas
title.pt-BR: Confira efeitos antes de ordenar dívidas

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Check consequences before sorting debts"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Revisa consecuencias antes de ordenar deudas"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Confira efeitos antes de ordenar dívidas"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Prioritize immediate consequences before applying a simple balance or rate ordering.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Immediate essential needs can change the order suggested by balance or interest rate alone.
instruction.misconception: Always paying the smallest balance, highest rate or loudest creditor before checking immediate consequences and essential needs.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: A simple ranking ignores urgent consequences. First check essential needs, due dates and stated risks; then compare feasible repayment choices.
The stated immediate consequence needs attention before a simple rate ordering.
Contact frequency does not measure urgency or financial consequence.
A repayment choice must fit essential needs and actual cash timing.
A smaller balance need not have the most urgent consequence.
Unverified pressure does not establish a legal consequence.
The feasible plan depends on needs, timing and verified consequences.
